text: CommandPolicy now carries distinct captureLimit and evidenceLimit. Capture is what parsers read; evidence retention is applied in SlurmCliScheduler after parsing, via new BoundedEvidence.retained(limit) which preserves originalByteCount. SlurmLocalConfig.default and AgentRuntimeConfig.fromEnvironment now capture at maximumCommandCapture and retain at defaultEvidence. Evidence: new LocalCaptureBoundSuite drives the real Fs2CommandExecutor and the shipped default config against a fake squeue emitting ~94 KB of valid JSON for 60 jobs; both tests pass. Reverting captureLimit to defaultEvidence makes the first test fail with exactly the predicted symptom: ParseFailed(invalid-squeue-json, detail -> exhausted input). local 22/22, cli 25/25.
